consequence.statement: CRDs installed separately must be bumped by applying the v0.16.1 CRD bundle and verifying no error occurs before migrating external-secrets to v0.16.1.
consequence.remediation: Run kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml, verify no error, then upgrade external-secrets.

assertion.statement: If CRDs are installed separately, the operator must first apply the updated CRD bundle (kubectl apply of deploy/crds/bundle.yaml) and verify no error before migrating external-secrets to v0.16.1.
